title: compliance-firewall Action
description: An agent intended action evaluated by compliance-firewall.

action_type.description: The kind of action being performed.

destination_region.description: ISO region code of the data destination (e.g. US, EU, CN). Empty means unspecified.

source_region.description: ISO region code where the data was collected. Empty means unspecified.

contains_pii.description: Whether the payload contains personally identifiable information.

purpose.description: Declared purpose of the action (e.g. analytics, marketing, support).

data_categories.description: Data categories involved (e.g. email, phone, health).

payload.description: Arbitrary payload; matching keys are scrubbed on redact.

actor.description: Optional identifier of the agent or user performing the action.
